name: Wealthsimple Visa Infinite+ Credit Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Fee waived with a monthly direct deposit of $4,000 or more to a Wealthsimple chequing account, or with $100,000 or more in individual assets with Wealthsimple.

apr.notes: 20.99% on purchases and 22.99% on cash advances and cash-like transactions; rates rise to 25.99% and 27.99% after 2 consecutive missed minimum payments.

credit_required.notes: Personal income of at least $80,000 or household income of at least $150,000, plus an active Wealthsimple chequing account.

base_rate.description: 2% cash back on every purchase; does not apply to cash-like transactions, refunds, or fees and adjustments.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back can be redeemed at any point to almost any Wealthsimple account.

signup_bonus.description: New Wealthsimple clients earn 5% cash back on everything for the first 5 weeks, then 2%.

notes: The fee is charged as $20 monthly for clients with under $100,000 in individual assets (recorded here as $240 a year); Quebec clients are charged annually. No foreign exchange fees from Wealthsimple. Requires an active Wealthsimple chequing account; Wealthsimple matches applicants to the Visa Infinite+ or Visa Infinite Privilege card. Network tier is Visa Infinite per the card name.
